summary: Menopause Matters is a monthly discussion and support series for people in perimenopause, menopause, or post-menopause, consistently hosted by Certified Menopause Coach Lisa Witler (WitFit) at the AmeriHealth Caritas Wellness + Opportunity Center in Asheville, with sponsorship from AARP Mountain Region. Each session brings a different guest speaker but the same host, format, and venue, and listings explicitly address an ongoing community ("the menopause menoposse") rather than one-off attendees.

evidence.note: Dec 2025 listing calls it 'the final gathering of the year' and welcomes people to 'join the menopause menoposse', explicit ongoing-group language.
Jan 2026 listing again hosted by Lisa Witler, describes recurring peer support and 'a welcoming group of women who get it', plus kid care during sessions implying regular attendance.
Feb 2026 listing keeps the same venue, host, and support-group framing three months running (Dec, Jan, Feb), monthly cadence.

AARP news search snippet confirms Menopause Matters is an AARP Mountain Region-sponsored series of supportive discussion groups led by Lisa Witler at the AmeriHealth Caritas wellness center, not a one-off talk.
Lisa Witler's WitFit business page lists Menopause Matters meetings among her offerings, confirming she is the consistent organizer/coach behind the series.
